Tiffany Nguyen is an Engineering undergraduate with an Emphasis in Environmental Analysis at [Harvey Mudd College](https://hmc.edu). Her main interest lies in robotics for extreme environments (climate and space), but particularly for the navgiation of challenging terrains. For example, she worked on a robotics mobility project for space exploration during Summer 2026 and will be continuing it. She has stronger interests in mechanical and software within robotics, but enjoy the challenge to learn the interactions between different works in robotics. She also have an interest in human-robot interactions (HRI) and was able to work with Harvey Mudd College's CACTI Lab research lab from Spring 2025 to Fall 2025, which engages in human-centered design (HCD) by working at the intersection of climate, computer science, and disabilities. By pursuing her interests, she hopes to engage in impactful engineering where robotics can support humans in navigating challenges and exploring possibilities.
